title: RULES if You're the Last Person in the Airport at 3 A.M. #shorts
description_hook: Your flight was cancelled and you fell asleep at the gate. Now the terminal is empty, and the boards show one flight. A work of fiction.

lines.text: STAY WHERE THE FLOOR IS CARPET
lines.say: You wake up alone at your gate at 3 A.M. Rule one: stay where the floor is carpet.
lines.img: an empty airport gate at night, rows of connected black seats on patterned carpet, rain streaking down huge dark windows, soft fluorescent light

lines.say: Rule two. The cleaning cart moves by itself. Let it pass.
lines.img: a lone janitor cleaning cart standing in the middle of a long glossy terminal corridor, no one pushing it, ceiling lights reflected in the polished floor

lines.say: Rule three. The moving walkway goes one way. Never walk against it.
lines.img: a long airport moving walkway running through an empty concourse at night, handrails gliding, the far end fading into dim blue light

lines.say: Rule four. If a boarding call says your name, don't answer.
lines.img: a round ceiling speaker above an empty boarding desk, a single lamp lit over the counter, blurred rows of seats behind it

lines.text: DON'T BOARD THE FLIGHT WITH NO DESTINATION
lines.say: Rule five. The board shows one flight. No destination. Don't board it.
lines.img: departure boards glowing amber in a dark empty terminal, every line blurred and unreadable, a closed jet bridge door beneath them

lines.say: Then the speaker says your flight is cancelled. Sit down. It's the start again.
lines.img: a single airport seat by a rain-covered window at night, a jacket folded on the armrest as if someone just fell asleep there, runway lights blurred outside

loop_back: The last line sends the viewer back to sleep in the gate seat where they woke up — the start of rule one.

gumi.say: So. Which rule would you break first?
